description: Based off of Osamu Dazai's novel "Schoolgirl". This work is a first-person female novel based on the diary of a girl who is a favorite reader of Tadashi, and was published in the 1939 magazine "Bungakukai". The story depicts May 1st of a year. In the words of a female student living in Tokyo, I draw the heart of adolescents who are self-conscious. "I want to live beautifully," says the girl.
